context_summary: The paper proposes a framework combining link prediction and large language models (LLMs) to generate conceptual solutions for product design. It includes case studies and evaluations of the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
exclusion_facts: The paper discusses the use of LLMs and link prediction methods but does not explicitly collect human subjective evaluations.
The case studies involve quantitative evaluations but do not include direct collection of human subjective perceptions or judgments.
The paper focuses on technical methods and framework development rather than on human perception or experience.
